@pytest.mark.django_db

@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_max_usages_in_batch(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    membership.membership_type.max_usages = 1
    membership.membership_type.save()
    cp1 = CartPosition(item=requiring_ticket, event=event, used_membership=membership)
    cp2 = CartPosition(item=requiring_ticket, event=event, used_membership=membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp1, cp2], event)
    assert 'no usages left' in str(excinfo.value.message)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_max_usages_existing_order(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    membership.membership_type.max_usages = 1
    membership.membership_type.save()
    order = Order.objects.create(event=event, status=Order.STATUS_PAID, expires=now() + timedelta(days=3),
                                 sales_channel=event.organizer.sales_channels.get(identifier="web"), total=4)
    OrderPosition.objects.create(order=order, item=requiring_ticket, price=23, used_membership=membership)
    cp = CartPosition(item=requiring_ticket, event=event, used_membership=membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)
    assert 'no usages left' in str(excinfo.value.message)

    # Usages of the order that is being changed do not count against the membership
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event, ignored_order=order)
